g.text: 10 seeds per alpha and profile; lines: medians; bands: Q1-Q3; dots: individual runs.
Dotted vertical: analytical branch switch, alpha = 0.68788. Error axis linear below 0.1%, logarithmic above.
Failed runs: 0; incomplete groups have no median/band. No retuning on this model.
